- Preserve unrelated bytes and stop on stale inputs or a scope conflict.

### Acceptance criteria

- Missing, stale, overbroad and memory-only grants fail; an ordinary child or competing manager cannot publish.
- Validation, capability discovery and ontology reads create no permission or Task/role mutation.

- Observe hashes of Task, role and memory canonical state across rejected and permitted isolated ontology publication.

## TASK-010 - Commit reviewed changes with durable recovery

Implement preview/publish and exact-operation recovery using confined paths, short-lived owned locks, expected bytes, durable transaction intent and immutable publication receipts.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-006, REQ-019, REQ-020 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/ontology_publication.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/tests/test_publication.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-009 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Preserve unrelated bytes and stop on stale inputs or a scope conflict.

### Acceptance criteria

- The receipt identifies reviewed inputs, actual committed files, prior/current digests, owner, reason and projection result.
- Concurrent writers, changed expected bytes and potentially active locks block mutation; recovery checks the recorded operation and preserves unrelated edits.
- A fault after canonical commit reports partial with bounded recovery; repeated delivery does not commit the same logical change twice or discard accepted recovery state.

### Planned verification

- Run transaction fault injection before/after commit and during projections and receipts; resume exact recorded operations.
- Compare preserved bytes and verify stale retry, competing lock and unexpected target fail safely.

## TASK-011 - Retain lifecycle history and provisional changes

Implement draft/approved/deprecated transitions, renewed review for changed approved semantics, retained deprecated IDs/reasons/replacements and proposal isolation.

### Risks

- Preserve unrelated bytes and stop on stale inputs or a scope conflict.

### Acceptance criteria

- Old IDs retain historical meaning and resolve after deprecation; changed meaning cannot inherit old approval or recycle identity.
- Suggestions and rejected/ambiguous extracted associations remain provisional; memory capture cannot publish ontology semantics.

### Planned verification

- Exercise draft approval, changed approved content, deprecation with and without replacement and rejected proposal retrieval.
- Invoke isolated memory publication/capture fixtures and verify canonical ontology hashes remain unchanged.
